objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "Open main menu, then Tools, then Search, and click Special:Book Book."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'main menu'.
2. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Tools'.
3. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Search'.
4. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Special:Book Book'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'main menu'; role=button; text="Main menu" | HINTS: container=site navigation
PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Tools'; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: container=Page tools navigation
PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Search'; role=button; text="Search" | HINTS: container=header search form
actions.instr: Clicking the Search button in the header search form
